name: Customer refund-status inquiry delivery kit (synthetic)
description: Proposed synthetic scenario for a read-only refund-status support view. It validates FDE proposal delivery and never establishes enterprise access, acceptance, integration, or write-back authority.

businessOwner.contact: synthetic role only; target-enterprise contact missing

processNode: Customer-service handling of a refund-status inquiry after the customer provides an order reference.
decisionOrAction: Present a read-only normalized refund status and response template for human confirmation, or abstain and route the inquiry to finance; never approve a refund or write back.

metrics.name: Average inquiry handling time
metrics.definition: Elapsed minutes from receipt of a refund-status inquiry to a customer-service representative confirming a response or routing an exception.

metrics.name: Incorrect refund-status response rate
metrics.definition: Share of shadow-replayed inquiries for which the confirmed response states a refund status inconsistent with the accepted finance-owned definition and source evidence.
metrics.target: must not increase from an accepted baseline (proposed)

ontologyReferences.purpose: Proposed synthetic definitions for the three supported normalized refund states, evidence fields, and exception routes. Finance owner acceptance is missing.

sourceReferences.purpose: Proposed read-only evidence bundle containing order identity, payment refund state, source timestamp, retrieval time, and access decision. No enterprise source or permission is established.

acceptanceCriteria: All three supported refund states map deterministically and expose source evidence, retrieval time, semantic version, and access decision.
Every missing, conflicting, stale, failed, rejected, disputed, prohibited, or unauthorized case abstains and routes to finance.
Average simulated handling time is no more than 3 minutes and incorrect refund-status responses do not increase.
The customer-service operations lead and finance refund owner accept the shadow result before any pilot is proposed.
No direct customer response, refund approval, compensation decision, payment-dispute handling, or persistent write-back occurs.
notes: Every scenario fact is proposed synthetic. Schema validity proves structure only and does not pass G1, G2, or any enterprise gate.
